openQuestions: Official name in English and Ukrainian, canonical domain and postal address, from the official site and the EDEBO register.
Dated official statement for the current academic year on whether, where and how foreign students are taught.
State registration (EDEBO), programme licence (Ministry or EDEBO licence register) and NAQA accreditation for each health programme: three separate claims.
Which medicine, dentistry, pharmacy or nursing programmes admit foreign applicants, in which language, with what duration and intake, and the official fee page.

Relocation lead (unverified): No relocation lead. Zhytomyr is government-controlled territory; 2026-cycle admission listings for the institute (vstup.osvita.ua y2026/r7/319) and its college (y2025/r7/1884) indicate ongoing intake in Zhytomyr. History lead: MON news (2017) "У Житомирі відкрили новий медичний інститут" — the communal HEI "Zhytomyr Medical Institute" was created on the basis of the Zhytomyr Institute of Nursing by decision of a Zhytomyr Regional Council session to allow new specialties. No merger, suspension or reorganisation news for 2025–2026 found; current rector not found.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No lead at all for admission of foreign applicants or English-medium teaching; the only 'international' lead is the FRSE phrase 'close cooperation with foreign partners'.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No higher-education programme in 222 Medicine, 221 Dentistry or 226 Pharmacy found; the institute is nursing-based (223) plus physical therapy and management. FRSE's 'Dentistry' and 'Public Health' claims are not corroborated by 2025/2026 admission catalogues; dentistry appears only at the professional-college sub-unit.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: 'Лікувальна справа' and 'Стоматологія' leads belong to the institute's фаховий коледж (vocational level) and must not be presented as medical or dental degree programmes.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Name confusion risk: Zhytomyr Polytechnic State University (ztu.edu.ua, separate technical university that dominated the English-language search results), Zhytomyr Institute of MAUP (private, vstup.osvita.ua r7/1186), Polissia National University (polissiauniver.edu.ua), and the predecessor name 'Zhytomyr Institute of Nursing' still used by aggregators.
Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Licence/accreditation status unverified: no EDEBO or NAQA record found in search; catalogue licensed-volume figures conflict (337 vs 394).
Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: PhD-in-Nursing licence claim (2026) comes from a third-party aggregator (plandiy.com.ua) only.
Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Fees (39,900 UAH/year master; 25,600 UAH/year college) are catalogue figures, not official and not for foreign students.
Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Inventory group G (communal nursing-level institute): likely outside the directory's scope of medical degree programmes for international applicants.
Missing evidence: Official site zhim.org.ua not opened: full legal name, founder, structure, rector, contacts unconfirmed.
Missing evidence: EDEBO extract: licence (specialties, levels, licensed volume) and accreditation certificates — none found; the 337 vs 394 licensed-volume conflict unresolved.
Missing evidence: NAQA register entry for 223 Nursing (bachelor/master) and any other accredited programme.
Missing evidence: Any official page on admission of foreign citizens (Rules of Admission section for foreigners, international office, invitation/visa process) — not found.
Missing evidence: Any evidence of English-medium instruction — not found.
Missing evidence: Confirmation whether 221 Dentistry and Public Health exist at higher-education level (FRSE claim) or only at the college sub-unit.
Missing evidence: Official fee schedule (the 39,900 and 25,600 UAH figures are catalogue leads).
Missing evidence: Date and legal act of the 2017 rename/establishment (Regional Council decision number).
Missing evidence: Verification of the aggregator PhD-licence claim (2026).
Missing evidence: MON Study in Ukraine portal page content beyond the ownership line (programmes, languages, contacts).
Skeptic's note: No lead at all for admission of foreign applicants or English-medium teaching (only FRSE's 'close cooperation with foreign partners').

Skeptic's note: Only nursing (223) degree leads at higher-education level: bachelor (nursing, midwifery, emergency-medicine specialisation) and master (2025 and 2026 vstup.osvita.ua cards, institution id 319). No 222 Medicine, 221 Dentistry or 226 Pharmacy degree lead; FRSE's 'Dentistry' and 'Public Health' claims are uncorroborated.

Skeptic's note: Licence and accreditation unverified: no EDEBO or NAQA record found; licensed-volume figures conflict (337 vs 394); the PhD-in-Nursing licence claim rests on one aggregator (plandiy.com.ua).
